title: Ticketing transaction launch certification
goal: Certify the complete ticket transaction lifecycle against the reconciled staged schema without anonymous or cross-tenant money access

in: Event publication, inventory, purchase, webhook, wallet and QR, transfer, check-in, refund, settlement, race, and idempotency behavior

acceptance_criteria: The deployed create-to-settlement ticket lifecycle passes against the reconciled staging schema
Purchase authentication, inventory races, webhook replay, idempotency, transfer, refund, and check-in concurrency are verified
Settlement remains append-only and unavailable data is never represented as a false zero
Anonymous and cross-tenant callers cannot read or mutate protected ticketing or money data

commands: npx vitest run __tests__/ticketing: 13 files, 95 tests passed
evidence: Audit baseline: existing E2E creates and publishes an event but does not complete purchase, payment webhook, transfer, QR/check-in, refund, or settlement as one deployed lifecycle.
Local implementation and focused tests only; no hosted staging claim
Typecheck interrupted after bounded window with no diagnostics; no hosted staging claim
